compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. mwcc emits three destructor variants from the one out-of-line definition -- D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (0x020d5a54, size 0x24) and D0 (0x020d5a78), which are adjacent: 0x020d5a78 - 0x020d5a54 = 0x24, exactly D1's size, so the image has no room for a D2 between them. include/dScMgBomroom_c.h records the class as a leaf (no RTTI record names it as a base), so its own D2 is never odr-used. _ZN14dScMgBomroom_cD2Ev appears in no symbols.txt and no delinks.txt anywhere in the tree, so it has no ROM home at all -- plain deadstrip, and production isolation discards it.

The class's own vtable, emitted because this TU owns the key function. config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt puts the address point at 0x0213bbb4 and the next row at 0x0213bc44, so the slot array is 0x90 = 36 slots (the dScMgBase_c length) and the storage, with its 8-byte offset-to-top/typeinfo preamble, is 0x0213bbac..0x0213bc44 = 0x98. notes: Widened from the 41-helper span 0x020d5eb8..0x020d7c4c to the whole unit. The folded files were _ZN14dScMgBomroom_cD1Ev.cpp and _D0Ev.cpp, the 12 helpers from _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c13DrawRoundOverEv to _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c12TopDoor_DrawEv, the 21 helpers from _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c15Bomb_StateInPenEi to _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c10ResetRoundEv, and the OnYoshiTryEat, Render, Behavior and InitResources files; attribution.json keeps each one's credit through a path#symbol override.

Written ROM-ASCENDING because `#pragma defer_codegen off` makes CodeWarrior emit each definition as it is encountered rather than in reverse source order. With the out-of-line destructor first in the file it emits D1, D0 at ordinals 0 and 1, and the homeless D2 is dispositioned deadstrip.

include/decl_common.h declares several of this TU's members. Those declared `void f(void*)` are defined with that spelling and cast to the recovered type on the first line, which is byte-neutral; call sites that reach a member defined with a typed parameter (_ZN14dScMgBomroom_c15PenGate_HideAllEv, _020d669c, _020d5dd4, _020d65c8, _020d6278, _020d5fec) cast at the call. _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c13DrawRemainingEv was declared `int f()` there -- decl_headers.py had read a legacy shard's K&R forward declaration -- and is corrected to `void f(void*)`. _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c12TopDoor_DrawEv was declared `void f()`, which C++ reads as taking no arguments and which conflicts with its `char *` definition here; that declaration is removed, since this file is its only caller. Bomroom_DrawScore keeps decl_common.h's `void f(void)`: it takes no argument, and Render calls it without one (the retired Render file passed `this`, which the callee never read; bytes are unchanged).

Each member keeps its own legacy shadow types, suffixed with the member's address (S_604c, Obj_6098, PMF_6278, Ent_816c, Work_893c, ...) so that the shards' independently-invented `S`/`C`/`Rec`/`Obj`/`Work`/`Ent`/`Entry` tags coexist. Members derived from .c shards had their `this` parameter renamed to `self_` -- a C++ keyword in the merged TU. The .c shards' `_ZN5Sound12PlayBank2_2DEj` calls are spelled Sound::PlayBank2_2D through include/Sound.h, and _ZN14dScMgBomroom_c15Round_StatePlayEv, recovered as returning the result of a void function through K&R declarations, is void.

The incomplete structs and PMF typedefs above the pointer-to-member dispatchers (C_5fec, C_6278, C_65c8, C_7c00, C_836c, C_91b0) are load-bearing: they are the representation the tables at sBomroomTopDoorStateTable..sBomroomBombStateTable are filled with, and completing a struct changes the pointer-to-member representation mwcc emits.

Static initializer folded: the seven state tables move out of src/unnamed/ov006/__sinit_ov006_0212fd48.c into this TU. Each table is the pointer-to-member type its dispatcher already calls through, plain-copied from the ROM pmf_dScMgBomroom_c_* constants in retail order. mwcc emits __sinit_d_s_mg_bomroom.cpp at 0x368 with the same 40 relocations. .init 0x0212fd48..0x021300b0, .ctor 0x02133580..0x02133584 and .bss 0x02141660..0x02141768 are this TU's. The PMF constants stay ROM data. No compiler temporaries.
